[WP] "Please tell me you're here to do something about the dust."

"Please tell me you're here to do something about the dust." Said the girl standing in front of him. The acolyte didn't know what to say, he'd only done elementary weather-working and this seemed to be a far more sizeable dust storm than the rainclouds they'd spent their time banishing. He wondered if he could do anything with his elementalism, his teacher had always said he was the best in the class with air magic, even if it was considered the weakest of the four.

"I'm actually just passing through" He said while shielding his eyes from the dust himself "but I shall see if I can do anything to help while I'm here, I'm only an acolyte you see, and I'm off to see a tutor that lives in the next city." He carefully put down his satchel full of books and threw some of his rudimentary weather working at the dust-storm.

It failed.

Te girl looked on as he began casting sigils in the air, they glowed with power as the storm seemed to be fighting against them, then they shattered, the acolyte flew backwards and landed heavily on his arse. The girl couldn't help but laugh at this, and helped him up. "You used elementalism just then didn't you, I never thought of using that to deal with it, I assumed it would take weather-working, like you tried at first, gimme 2 ticks." The acolyte only really looked at the girl at this point, she was dressed practically for the weather, in strong boots and tough clothes. He was taken aback when she started throwing her own sigils into the air. It was elementalism like he'd never seen before, the complexity of it seemed vast and he wondered how the sigils could possibly hold.

Hold they did, and the dust just fell out of the air. "Now all I had to do all this time was cast a 14th teir air stabilisation sigil mized with a 9th teir weighted earth sigil that had a targeting sigil on the dust itself, so that any remnants of wind couldn't pick it up. I'd always left weather to the weather-workers but that worked far better than I was expecting." She had notable glee on her face as she removed the mask that was keeping the dust out. "You're Simly aren't you, I have a hunch I'm the tutor you were after."
